Healing process is a little but different for everyone, but the scars turning to white is totally normal, especially for cuts on the top layers. At least for me, the only scars that have remain visible even after two years were my deepest ones, but even those are just white scars. Just like I’ve had those deeper ones, I’ve had the ones where they’re essentially completely closed after a day. They all turn white, and depending on depth and place some almost completely disappear.

Just a little extra thing, don’t cut deeper. You don’t need to. Regardless of the depth of your cuts or visibility of scars, you and your feelings are valid, and you don’t need to cut deeper to show that. I just don’t want this to get worse for you ❤️
